findings.evidence: `structure SectionChartData` and `def AETransition` are at Sobolev/Basic.lean:159 and :235. Sobolev/Atlas/Equiv.lean imports `Sobolev.Chart.Basic`, `Sobolev.ContMDiffSection` and `FiniteBundleAtlas.Measure`. Sobolev/Bordered/Basic.lean imports only `Sobolev.Basic`, `FiniteBundleAtlas.HalfPlane` and local Sobolev modules, none of the boundaryless chart modules. The new bordered file has `public import TauCeti.Geometry.Manifold.VectorBundle.Sobolev.Atlas.Equiv`.
findings.fix: Move the whole `ChartData` section into its own module next to the `SectionChartData` theory, e.g. `Sobolev/ChartData/ChangeAtlas.lean`, importing `Sobolev.Basic` and `Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Banach`. Have both `Sobolev/Atlas/Equiv.lean` and `Sobolev/Bordered/Atlas/Equiv.lean` import that module, and drop the bordered file's import of the boundaryless `Sobolev.Atlas.Equiv`.
findings.issue: `section ChartData` (`SectionChartData.ReadsFrom`, `readsFrom_refl`, `ReadsFrom.coord_ae_eq`, `TransfersTo`, `transfersTo_refl`, `TransfersTo.trans`, `changeAtlas`, `chartValueL_changeAtlas_ae`, `changeAtlas_eq_of_ae_eq_coord`, `changeAtlas_refl_apply`, `changeAtlas_changeAtlas`, `changeAtlas_injective`, `lowerOrderL_changeAtlas`, `exists_norm_changeAtlas_le`) depends only on `SectionChartData` but lives in the boundaryless `SobolevSection` atlas file. As a result `Sobolev/Bordered/Atlas/Equiv.lean` must import `Sobolev.Atlas.Equiv`, and with it `Sobolev.Chart.Basic`, `Sobolev.ContMDiffSection` and `FiniteBundleAtlas.Measure`, which the bordered theory otherwise does not use.

summary: The generic SectionChartData change-of-chart-data construction (ReadsFrom, TransfersTo, changeAtlas and lemmas) is placed in the boundaryless SobolevSection atlas file, forcing the bordered file to import the whole boundaryless chart-Sobolev stack. The half-plane lemmas and Bordered/Basic wrappers are placed correctly.
